accessGaps: X searches covered grouped SN numbers and selected primary accounts; they are sampled public results, not an exhaustive account-by-account or private-channel census.

Internal model results, commercial accounting, paid product runs and the full history of indexed wallet trades were not independently reproduced. No undisclosed sale price or beneficial owner is inferred.

decisions.reason: The +20.09% alpha/TAO move has no newly verified operational catalyst in the current numbered search or available brief. The October20 allocation story remains separately dated; no new emission event occurred in the reviewed interval.

primaryCommitChecks.message:
Bump certifi to 2026.10.23 (eMudhra CA distrust) (#818)

certifi < 2026.10.19 bundles emSign ECC Root CA - G3, whose
intermediates were issued with trivially recoverable keys
(GHSA-6q48-6c7w-9gw2). requests uses certifi's bundle, so the
validator's and miners' HTTPS calls to chain RPCs trusted it.

Co-authored-by: anderdc <me@alexanderdc.com>

Merge pull request #396 from Desearch-ai/develop

Page Extraction V2 and increased miner emissions

Update tokio to 1.54.1 for RUSTSEC-2026-0386 (#352)

Bumps tokio to 1.54.1 to resolve RUSTSEC-2026-0386.

Update Janitor's Disk mgmt

Merge pull request #162 from conjectures-io/dev

Release 16 historical open problems

Distrust the eMudhra roots Mozilla removed (Oct 2026 weak-key incident): certifi>=2026.10.23 for Python clients (requests, boto3), and the images drop emSign ECC Root CA G3, ECC C3 and Root CA C1 from the system store used by aiohttp, websockets and curl; the build fails if any is still there. emSign Root CA G1 stays trusted, as in Mozilla's store

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Flip-incentive SHADOW docs + audit helper (LIVE still v9/seq7) (#88)

Sync dashboard/public/llms.txt with the live Oct 23 flip-shadow section

a read-only audit CLI. No miner client protocol change; LIVE weights stay
v9/seq7.
